images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One exquisite wide 16:9 luxury fashion campaign photograph for Amnaya, a heritage conscious fashion house in Mauritius. TWO elegant adult Indian-Mauritian women with natural brown skin and natural expressive faces in their early 30s, full body, separated by generous negative space, walking along a sun washed old tropical colonial veranda. Woman on LEFT THIRD wears a sophisticated muted olive green linen sleeveless waistcoat and fluid wide leg trousers. Woman on RIGHT THIRD wears a warm sand coloured relaxed long-sleeve linen shirt and matching long skirt. Sculptural small brass earrings. Both outfits clear and believable, contemporary quiet luxury. Faded coral and cream plaster, old carved teak shutters, soft palm shadow, sliver of ocean and palms beyond. Cinematic late afternoon sunlight, tactile linen and analog medium format photography, warm subdued tones, balanced candid movement, beautifully art directed Vogue editorial. Each woman must be far enough apart to individually crop her from the original wide frame as a portrait. No typography, logos, frames, collage or watermark. This is an original creative collection concept, not documentary or real product inventory.
